Case 1: Female from Group A
- Group A: choose 1 female from 3 and 1 male from 5: \(\binom{3}{1}\binom{5}{1}=15\)
- Group B: choose 2 males from 6: \(\binom{6}{2}=15\)
- Total: \(15 \cdot 15 = 225\)

Case 2: Female from Group B
- Group A: choose 2 males from 5: \(\binom{5}{2}=10\)
- Group B: choose 1 female from 2 and 1 male from 6: \(\binom{2}{1}\binom{6}{1}=12\)
- Total: \(10 \cdot 12 = 120\)

Total ways: \(225 + 120 = 345\)

\boxed{345}
